prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

Lift ev’ry voice and sing, Till earth and heaven ring, Ring with the harmonies of Liberty; Let our rejoicing rise High as the list’ning skies, Let it resound loud as the rolling sea. Sing a song full of the faith that the dark past has taught us, Sing a song full of the hope that the present has brought us; Facing the rising sun of our new day begun, Let us march on till victory is won. Stony the road we trod, Bitter the chast’ning rod, Felt in the days when hope unborn had died; Yet with a steady beat, Have not our weary feet Come to the place for which our fathers sighed? We have come over a way that with tears has been watered, We have come, treading our path through the blood of the slaughtered, Out from the gloomy past, Till now we stand at last Where the white gleam of our bright star is cast. God of our weary years, God of our silent tears, Thou who has brought us thus far on the way; Thou who has by Thy might, Led us into the light, Keep us forever in the path, we pray. Lest our feet stray from the places, our God, where we met Thee, Lest our hearts, drunk with the wine of the world, we forget Thee; Shadowed beneath Thy hand, May we forever stand. True to our God, True to our native land.

outputs.L3:
Here is an expanded, well-structured text based on the bullet points:

***

At its heart, this song serves as a ringing clarion call for all people to unite and loudly celebrate the gift of liberty. It urges us to sing out with a joy that connects our history to our destiny, weaving together a profound faith forged in the crucible of past struggles with an unwavering hope for the future. It is a powerful reminder that true freedom is both a joyful celebration and a sacred responsibility.

This triumph, however, was not easily won. The journey toward the present day has been a long and arduous one, marked by a stony path steep with sacrifice. Generations before us endured intense suffering, treading through tears, bloodshed, and bitter injustice. Yet, despite the immense weight of this oppression, the people refused to be broken. Through extraordinary resilience and determination, they persevered through the darkest nights of adversity to finally step into the sunlight of a brighter, more promising present.

Throughout this harrowing history, God is recognized as the ultimate source of strength and deliverance. It was divine providence that sustained a weary people when human endurance reached its limits, offering comfort in times of grief and courage in times of fear. As a guiding beacon in the darkness, God led them step-by-step out of the shadows of captivity, directing their feet into the radiant light of freedom and opportunity.

Looking toward the horizon, the song concludes with a humble and earnest prayer. It is a heartfelt plea for God to keep the people on the right path, guarding them against pride, forgetfulness, or straying from their purpose. Ultimately, it stands as a solemn vow: that as long as future generations rise, they will remain forever steadfast in their spiritual faith and deeply devoted to the native land they have suffered so much to build.
outputs.L4:
For generations, the weight of history has been carved deep with the scars of profound oppression and unyielding suffering. It is a heritage marked by the heavy silence of injustice, where countless souls endured the crushing weight of systemic cruelty. Yet, in the darkest shadows of this past, a quiet, resonant truth refused to be extinguished: that no chain can forever bind the human spirit when a people choose to rise together. We are called today to confront that painful history—not to drown in its bitterness, but to transcend it. Through the harmonious power of collective song, we weave our individual griefs into a tapestry of strength, raising a unified voice that echoes across the valleys of our shared experience. Guided by a steadfast faith that sees beyond present hardships and anchored in prayerful determination, we press relentlessly toward the sacred promise of liberty.

The road we have traveled was steep and stony, marked by the chastening rod and watered by the tears of those who bled for a future they would never see. There were moments when despair threatened to consume us, when the night felt endless and the burden too heavy to bear. Yet, prayer became our compass, and faith our unshakeable foundation. We marched on through the storm, believing in a freedom that was not yet visible, sustained by the deep conviction that righteousness would ultimately prevail.

Consequently, through decades of relentless struggle and endurance, we have successfully emerged from the crucible of that painful past into a present illuminated by hope and liberation. The dark clouds of yesterday have parted, revealing the bright sunshine of a new era. This present moment is a testament to the enduring power of human resilience—a proof that a spirit forged in the fires of adversity cannot be broken. We stand today as the living fulfillment of our ancestors' prayers, walking in the light of rights reclaimed and dignity restored.

Yet, as we celebrate this hard-won freedom, we recognize that our journey is not complete. With humbled hearts, we affirm a lasting commitment to spiritual devotion, offering prayers of gratitude to the divine power that has brought us thus far on the way. May we never grow drunk with the wine of the world, nor forget the sacrifices that paved our path. Bound together by our history, our faith, and our shared destiny, we pledge ourselves anew to the ideals of true patriotism—building a nation rooted in justice, equality, and love. Standing firm in our devotion to God and country, we march onward, forever resolute, until liberty and peace belong to all.

The rain had been falling steadily since dawn, casting a cozy, rhythmic quiet over the old corner bakery. Inside, Arthur went about his evening routine with practiced ease. He paused to **lift** a heavy tray of cooling loaves from the counter, setting it onto the rack with a satisfied sigh. It had been a long day on his feet, but the simple joy of his craft always brought a subtle **lift** to his spirits.

Walking over to the front desk, he tapped the key to finalize the day’s receipts. With a familiar metallic chime, the heavy drawer of the antique **till** slid open, exposing the neatly arranged coins and notes. Arthur counted the day's earnings carefully, working steadily **till** the grand pendulum clock in the corner began to chime seven, marking the end of the shift.

He locked the register and reached for his coat, ready to close up for the night. But just as he turned the lock, the brass bell hanging above the heavy oak door gave a bright, unexpected **ring**. A familiar regular stepped inside out of the damp evening air, bringing a cool draft and a warm smile that promised one last pleasant conversation before the day was done.
